title: Oven Roasted British Rice Victoria Sponge
description: A cultured, crisp, solo-dinner British dish featuring bay leaves and fry-grind-rice-khao-khua in a Victoria sponge form, cooked in a paella pan. This nut-free-friendly recipe is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the self-raising flour, granulated sugar, and melted unsalted butter.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and whole milk.
Add the fry-grind-rice-khao-khua to the egg mixture and stir until well combined.
Add the egg mixture to the flour mixture and stir until a smooth batter forms.
Pour the batter into a paella pan lined with parchment paper.
Place the bay leaves on top of the batter.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the sponge is golden brown and cooked through.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
